theorem etcdstart.kvModel_boot (γk : KVNames) (ps : List w64) (bootLog : List EntryM) (hb :
    srvBootLogOk ps bootLog) : kvModel γk (bootEntries bootLog) = γk.log0

def etcdstart.BootFacts (id : w64) (ctxs : List (List w8)) (bl : List LogEntry) : Prop :=
  BootCore [id] ctxs bl

theorem etcdstart.BootFacts.idLow {id : w64} {ctxs : List (List w8)} {bl : List LogEntry} (h :
    etcdstart.BootFacts id ctxs bl) : uint.Z id % 2 ^ 16 ≠ 0

def etcdstart.dir1 (peer : GoString) (id : w64) : w64 → List GoString :=
  dirOne id (go!"http://" ++ peer)

def etcdstart.premises (name peer client : GoString) (N : Nat) (id : w64) (ctxs : List (List w8))
    (boot : List LogEntry) : IProp GF :=
  iprop((□
        ∀ cfg U γ,
          ⌜etcdstart.cfgOk name name cfg ∧
                etcdstart.urls1 name peer client U ∧
                  γ.vs = [id] ∧
                    γ.rule = srvRule (W64 0) (LogEntry.toEntries boot 0) ∧ γ.boot = LogEntry.toEntries boot 0⌝ -∗
            bootstrapContract cfg U γ id ctxs N (etcdstart.dir1 peer id)) ∗
      bootMarshal [id] ctxs (LogEntry.toEntries boot 0) ∗
        rnLoggerZapOk ∗ rnTimeoutDetectorOk ∗ rnNewStorageOk ∗ v3rpc.runsNoRequireLeader)

theorem etcdstart.premises_persistent (name peer client : GoString) (N : Nat) (id : w64) (ctxs :
    List (List w8)) (boot : List LogEntry) : Persistent (etcdstart.premises name peer client N id
    ctxs boot)
